name: Lattice Quest Realised
summary: A quest woven through the lattice is realised at last. Light moves along the threads from node to node until it rests on the one at its heart — the pattern holds, and the story it carried is complete.
comment: Phase W — fires when a lattice-born quest is realised. Slow zoom on quest's anchor NPC, three lattice-node light pulses, dwell.
